title: MADE: Beyond Scoring via a Multilingual Agentic Diagnosing Engine for Fine-Grained Evaluation Insights

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model behavior on cross-cultural conflict prompts and cultural knowledge benchmarks (SAGE, SUPERBLEND, CULTURESCOPE) to identify issues like stereotype compliance and cultural stance divergence. The system uses a 'Language Reflector' agent to audit for cultural sensitivity.

Analyzing model performance across 26 languages to surface language-specific failure modes, specifically identifying where overall leadership fails to transfer to low-resource linguistic contexts and auditing for 'English-centric' extrapolation in model reasoning.
